$schema_note: Not a real JSON Schema; documents the contract for humans/xUnit/pytest.
description: Reader parity vectors (issue #393): the exact records, notices and error text the worker's readers/fasta.py (read_fasta) and readers/genbank.py (read_genbank) produce for a fixed set of inputs. worker/tests/test_readers_parity.py replays every case against the Python readers; the C# FastaLiteTests/GenBankLiteTests replay the same file against FastaLite/GenBankLite. A wording change in either reader fails the test on its side until the fixture and both ports agree. GenBankLite is deliberately partial (LOCUS/ORIGIN/gene-CDS counts only), so a case compares records' sequences and gene counts, notices and error text; where the port's text deliberately differs, the case carries `csharp_divergence` (the port's own expected value, with the reason).

source.generated_by: A one-off script run against the worker at fixture-build time (Python readers called on a temp file per case, then deleted, not committed); the Python test re-derives every value.
